text.aria-label: Title text 'A 7-day step of +10% of capacity in the fine-tuning targets, seen at one signed-MW Primary. Forecast issued at the week-3 refit of the 2026-01 fold. Line: median. text.tspan: A 7-day step of +10% of capacity in the fine-tuning targets, seen at one signed-MW Primary.
Forecast issued at the week-3 refit of the 2026-01 fold.
Line: median. Dark band: 50% interval; light band: 90% interval. Black: actual. Dashed: the same arm refitted without the step.
